NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: AMOLED Dark Mode For UI
patches.description: Makes the dark UI pure black.

patches.name: Alert distances
patches.description: How early alerts sound, plus a speed-bump switch and per-alert distances.

options.title: Alert distance level
options.description: Standard is Waze's own. Moderate and Heavier warn earlier - about 1.5x and 2.5x on average; cameras change more than police.

options.title: Speed bump (ramp) warnings
options.description: Waze nags about speed bumps ahead. Off silences them; stock is on.

options.title: Police
options.description: 0 = keep the preset, Standard 600 m.

options.title: Hazards
options.description: 0 = keep the preset, Standard 600 m.

options.title: Crashes
options.description: 0 = keep the preset, Standard 600 m.

options.title: Traffic jams
options.description: 0 = keep the preset, Standard 600 m.

options.title: Speed cams - streets
options.description: 0 = keep the preset, Standard 500 m.

options.title: Speed cams - highways
options.description: 0 = keep the preset, Standard 1000 m.

options.title: Speed cams - freeways
options.description: 0 = keep the preset, Standard 2000 m.

options.title: Blocked lanes
options.description: 0 = keep the preset, Standard 400 m.

options.title: Gap between alerts
options.description: 0 = keep the preset, Standard 300 m.

patches.name: Allow high refresh rate
patches.description: Runs above 60 Hz, up to your screen's limit.

options.title: Target refresh rate (Hz)
options.description: Refresh rate ceiling. 120 suits most phones; lower it if the phone gets hot.

patches.name: Auto zoom
patches.description: Keeps your auto-zoom choice from being reset.

options.title: Auto-zoom mode
options.description: speed = zoom out progressively with speed, yes = always on, no = off.

patches.name: Brief voice guidance
patches.description: Shorter spoken directions.

patches.name: Cameras & hazards
patches.description: Shows every camera and road hazard, with switches for the extra kinds.

options.title: Average-speed zones
options.description: Average-speed zone feature and recommended speed. Stock: on.

options.title: Camera chime below the limit
options.description: Plays the camera sound even when you are under the limit. Stock: on.

options.title: The other camera types
options.description: Phone, bus, carpool, HOV and noise cameras. Experimental.

options.title: Crosswalk hazards
options.description: Highway and raised crosswalks drawn on the map and announced. Stock: off.

patches.name: Car alerts as notifications
patches.description: Shows car alerts as notifications.

patches.name: Car map zoom
patches.description: Zooms the map on the car screen.

options.title: Car map zoom
options.description: Map scale on the car screen.

patches.name: Car trip screen text
patches.description: Adds arrival time and time left to the car trip bar.

patches.name: Change Waze icon
patches.description: Reaper artwork, the stock ghost in any colour, or your own image (square PNG/JPG/WebP, 432x432 recommended, 192x192 minimum).

options.title: Icon
options.description: Forsigh Reaper, the stock Waze ghost, or your own picture.

options.title: Ghost background
options.description: Only used by the Waze ghost option. Stock is #FF33CCFF.

options.title: Hide launch logo
options.description: Also drops the Waze ghost from the launch screen. The launch colour comes from the Launch screen row.

options.title: Custom image
options.description: Square, 432x432 recommended, 192x192 minimum. PNG, JPG or WebP. Fills the icon.

patches.name: Disable Play Store updates
patches.description: Stops the Play Store updating Waze.

patches.name: Enable police & enforcement alerts
patches.description: Turns police and enforcement alerts on.

patches.name: Extra map info
patches.description: Compass always shown and toll price on routes.

options.title: Always show compass
options.description: Keeps the compass on the map. Stock: only while turning.

options.title: Toll price on route
options.description: Shows what the toll costs on each route. Stock: hidden.

patches.name: Hide recent destinations
patches.description: Keeps the places you navigated to out of every recent list. Waze still stores them.

patches.name: Instrument cluster support
patches.description: Shows the map and alerts on the car's cluster screen.

options.title: Large cluster layout
options.description: Uses the bigger layout on the cluster. Stock: small.

patches.name: Keep Waze alive
patches.description: Stops Waze closing when you leave it.

options.title: Where
options.description: Which surface stays alive.

options.title: Minutes alive
options.description: Phone background timeout and the Android Auto shutdown delay. Waze's own cap is 10.

patches.name: Lane guidance
patches.description: Shows lane guidance, including straight-ahead hints.

patches.name: Launch screen background colour
patches.description: Colour behind the Waze logo while the app starts. #00000000 makes it transparent.

options.title: Background colour
options.description: Pick a colour, or choose Custom colour and type your own hex.

options.title: Custom colour
options.description: Only used when Launch screen is set to Custom colour.

patches.name: Live drive sharing
patches.description: Adds the hidden share-your-drive link.

patches.name: Morphe YouTube Music as a Waze audio partner
patches.description: Lets Morphe YouTube Music play through Waze.

patches.name: New alert icons
patches.description: Uses Waze's newer alert icons.

patches.name: No Android Auto telemetry
patches.description: Stops Waze sending Android Auto screen-switch timings to its analytics.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture
patches.description: Floats Waze in a 9:16 window every time you leave it. Known issues: touch does not work on the floating window, and the UI does not scale down.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Removes ads.

options.title: Block beacon popups
options.description: Waze's promotional beacon popups. Stock: shown.

patches.name: Rename app
patches.description: Stock name by default. Type your own to replace what the launcher shows. The package stays com.waze.

options.title: App name
options.description: Leave Waze for the stock name, or type your own (40 characters max).

patches.name: Show FPS counter
patches.description: Shows the frame-rate counter.

patches.name: Skip sign-in
patches.description: Starts as a guest, straight to the map.

patches.name: Smoother Android Auto map
patches.description: Smooths map movement on Android Auto.

patches.name: Speed limits
patches.description: Sign always shown, limit-drop warnings, reporting and sign style.

options.title: Sign always shown
options.description: Keeps the limit sign on screen when you are under the limit. Stock: hides.

options.title: Limit-drop warnings
options.description: Warns when the limit falls, 1000 m ahead. Stock: on.

options.title: Report the speed limit
options.description: Adds the report-limit option. Stock: off.

options.title: Sign style
options.description: Waze picks one by country; this forces it.

patches.name: Speedometer & limit sign
patches.description: Size of the speedometer and limit sign, and keeps them on screen.

options.title: Always show speedometer
options.description: Keeps the speedometer on screen from the first drive. Stock: appears after a few sessions.

options.title: Speedometer size
options.description: Ring, speed number and unit.

options.title: Speed limit sign size
options.description: The limit sign next to the speedometer.

patches.name: Theme
patches.description: Picks the map theme for day and night.

options.title: Day theme
options.description: The day map's theme. Stock leaves it untouched.

options.title: Night theme
options.description: The night map's theme. Stock leaves it untouched.

patches.name: Traffic meter
patches.description: Shows the traffic meter on the car screen.

patches.name: Unlock driver moods
patches.description: Unlocks all moods on the device.
